metadata.name: Refactoring engine
metadata.capas: frontend, backend, or full-stack. Full-stack order is shared contract, backend, frontend, integrator.

requerido.proposito: Source of functional truth and behavior that must be preserved
requerido.como_producir: Lifecycle phase srs after discovery, or paste templates/lifecycle/fase.md with phase srs.

requerido.proposito: Source of architectural truth, boundaries, and allowed contract changes
requerido.como_producir: Lifecycle phase sad after SRS and database, or promote an existing architecture document that matches the format.

requerido.proposito: Scope of stories and priorities; prevents silent scope drift
requerido.como_producir: Lifecycle phase backlog using the canon generator, or a current backlog that already passed validation.

requerido.proposito: Verification source; defines how behavior is proven before and after refactor
requerido.como_producir: Workflow workflows/documents/test-documentation.xml mode strategy, from the current SRS and discovered test commands.

compuerta.busqueda: Read-only search in lifecycle and legacy paths. If both paths are absent or empty, the document counts as missing.

ausente.regla: Do not edit code. Do not start analysis beyond locating files. Write the message in the user's language using language.xml.

secciones_salida.seccion: Why refactoring cannot start and what the user must supply.

One subsection per missing id. Each subsection MUST include: Purpose, Primary path, Legacy path, Format contract (path under .ai-vexarq/formats/), How to produce (phase template or workflow), Minimum content checklist (3–5 bullets from the format index).
List ids that were found with the path used.
If the user named an equivalent document in this request, record it here with limitations. Otherwise write: None.
Numbered steps for the user: create or promote each missing file, then re-run the same template.

compuerta.excepcion: The user may name a substitute source of truth in the conversation. Record the substitution, its limit, and the risk in the assessment. Do not invent the substitution.

fases.fase: Confirm scope, goals, non-goals, and the definition of done.
Run the quality-pipeline baseline. Add characterization tests before changing weakly tested behavior.
Analyze debt, boundaries, and contracts. Call security, complexity, or performance auditors only when the factory routing rule says so.
Plan small behavior-preserving steps. Name the technique and the rollback. Prefer expand, migrate, and contract for data and APIs.
Execute one step at a time. After each code change, rerun the quality pipeline from G-00.
Compare the final behavior with the baseline. A public contract changes only when the SRS allows it.

prohibido.regla: Do not delete or weaken a test to finish a refactor.
If the change would contradict the SAD, stop and propose an ADR.
Do not copy backend or frontend policies into this file. Reference them.
